answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake that is locked for a fixed window and released only after its work is attested. Each agent emits a regular heartbeat pulse proving liveness, and peers mirror the stake ledger so no single registry can mint identities silently. A lone attacker must fund a whole canyon of fake accounts at once, so the cost of flooding the network grows linearly with the number of sock puppets while honest agents pay only one small deposit.
